tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The on-going litigation is pending with CESTAT Bangalore. Details of dispute - excise demand u/s 11A of Central Excise Act, due to denial of CENVAT in respect of various Engineering, Procurement and Construction contracts entered at the time of integrated refinery expansion project at Kochi Refinery on the ground that such input service is not covered under the definition of ‘input service’ as provided under Rule 2(l) of Cenvat Credit Rules, 2004(CCR). Further denial of CENVAT also on the ground that credit is availed by artificially vivisecting the said single work orders into various categories of work.
tax_litigation.status: Pending with CESTAT Bangalore.

tax_litigation.status: Pending with CESTAT Mumbai.

tax_litigation.status: Pending with Supreme Court.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Certain disputes arose between BPCL and VVF India Ltd under the Long Term Gas Sales Agreement dated 9.12.2009 with respect to failure to take delivery of the agreed quantity of gas and consequent failure to make payments under the 'take or pay' obligation. Accordingly, BPCL issued Notice Invoking Arbitration dated 26.12.2022 Claiming top pay of Rs. 11619622715/. The same was disputed and culminated into arbitration.
tax_litigation.status: The Arbitral award has been passed wherein partial claim of BPCL has been allowed. Further, as on date no notice from court has been received w.r.t. any appeal by VVF. BPCL has sent a notice to VVF claiming the awarded amount.

operating_notes.text: Refinery throughput for FY26 stood at 41.15 MMT.
IBV Brasil Petroleo LTDA total investment in the SEAP-I project is expected to be ~ USD 2.8 Bn.
BPCL issued postal ballot notice for restructuring Mozambique Area-1 project AssetCo structure (USD 1,290.50 million) and extending DSU guarantee support up to USD 1,920 million.
Approved incorporation of a Wholly Owned Subsidiary as a dedicated project company for the Greenfield Refinery & Petrochemical Complex at Ramayapatnam with an authorised capital of up to ₹4,900 Cr.
Q2FY27 GRM stood at $32.53/bbl with refinery throughput at 10.41 MMT.
Crisil Ratings reaffirmed Crisil AAA/Stable on ₹1,05,000 Cr bank loan facilities, ₹10,000 Cr NCDs, and Crisil A1+ on ₹14,000 Cr commercial paper programs.

holders.name: NPS TRUST- A/C SBI PENSION FUND PVT LTD APY FUND S

timeline.summary: BPCL shareholders approved material related party transactions with Petronet LNG for FY27 via postal ballot with 99.39% majority.
BPCL released its financial handout for Q4 and FY26, reporting a PAT of ₹3,191 crore and total throughput of 41.15 MMT.
Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited shared the audio recording of its conference call on 20th May 2026 for audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26.
BPCL announced that its consortium in Brazil signed an FPSO contract for the SEAP-I Project with an expected investment of USD 2.8 billion.
BPCL issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for restructuring Mozambique LNG project assets and extending DSU guarantee support up to ₹18,432 crore.
BPCL's board approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary for the Greenfield Refinery & Petrochemical Complex at Ramayapatnam with an initial authorised capital of up to ₹4,900 Cr.
Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited rescheduled its 2Q FY27 Post Results Conference Call to **Monday, 26th October 2026 at 11:00 a.m. (IST)** due to business exigency, signed by **V. Kala (CFO)**.
BPCL reported Q2FY27 PBT of ₹6,686 Cr and PAT of ₹4,993 Cr, supported by a higher GRM of $32.53/bbl.
Audio recording of conference call on 26th October 2026 regarding unaudited financial results for quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 is available on company website.
Crisil Ratings reaffirmed Crisil AAA/Stable and Crisil A1+ ratings on BPCL's bank loans and debt instruments totalling ₹1,29,000 Cr.
